Maximum energy of emitted electrons is independent of intensity, OR no emission of electrons below threshold frequency regardless of intensity, OR no emission of electrons when photon energy is less than work function regardless of intensity.
in darkness: conduction band empty so no conduction
in daylight: electrons in valence band absorb energy
in daylight: electrons 'jump' to conduction band
this leaves holes in valence band
more charge carriers in daylight so resistance is lower
